title: Wich'sAntiFreeCam
description: An advanced anti-cheat plugin that detects and prevents freecam exploits
body:
🛡️ Wich’s AntiFreeCam

Tired of players spying on your server using FreeCam mods? Wich’s AntiFreeCam shuts that down instantly.

This plugin detects and prevents players from abusing FreeCam to look through walls, locate bases, or gain unfair advantages. Keep your server fair, competitive, and cheat-free without ruining normal gameplay.

✨ Features:

🚫 Detects FreeCam and similar exploits
⚡ Instant prevention of unfair camera movement
🔍 Protects hidden bases and private areas
🧠 Smart detection to avoid false bans
🛠️ Easy to set up and lightweight

Perfect for SMP, PvP, and survival servers that actually care about fairness.

💬 Why use it?
Because nobody likes that one guy acting like he’s got x-ray vision + drone mode combined.
